actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Welcome to Safe To Go training for Rebin Cart Operations.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Today, we’ll go through how to handle, move, and park a Rebin Cart safely while working as a Spider.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Before we head out, let’s make sure you’ve got the right PPE on.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Put on your reflective vest, safety shoes, and impact-resistant gloves.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Make sure all your PPE is on before we continue.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"You still have some PPE left. Put it on to continue.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"You’re all set. Before we head out, let’s get familiar with the Rebin Cart.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: ChecklistUIToggle
actions.Data: {"titleText":"Rebin Cart Operations – Rebin Cart Familiarization","toggleInfos":["Rebin Cart Overview","Pre-Checks","2×2×2×2 rule","Grab the Rebin Cart","Move the Rebin Cart","Practice Calling “Corner”"],"waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"These are the two Rebin Carts used here — the MULTI S and the MULTI TP.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The cart you use depends on the size of the items being handled.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"We’ll be using this one for today’s task.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Before we move it, let’s make sure it’s safe to use.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Look at the wheels, trays, and the overall condition.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"If anything looks damaged or out of place, touch it to report the issue.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Good catch. This cart isn’t safe to use.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Take another look around the cart and touch anything that looks unsafe.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"There’s something wrong with this tray. Touch it to report the issue.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Damaged carts are tagged and moved to the Red Tag area. I’ll take care of that for you.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Here’s a safe cart. Before you move it, let’s look at the right way to handle it.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Two feet move at a normal walking pace.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"And keep about two metres between you and other associates.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"That’s the 2-by-2-by-2-by-2 rule. Keep it in mind whenever you’re moving a cart.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Alright, go ahead and take hold of the handle with both hands.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Hold the cart handle with both hands.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grab the highlighted handle with both hands.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Good. Keep both hands on the handle and your elbows tucked in.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"When you’re moving a cart, always push from behind — never pull it.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Go ahead and push your hands slightly forward to get moving.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Push your hands slightly forward to get the cart moving.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Push forward to move the cart along the marked path.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"There’s one more thing you’ll need when you’re moving through the work area.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"At crossings and blind corners, call ‘Corner’ before you enter.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Say it out loud, just like you would on the floor.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"You hit someone. Stay alert and call ‘Corner’ before turning. Restart and remember to call ‘Corner’ this time.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Good. That lets anyone coming from the other side know you’re there.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Good. Keep doing that throughout this training, and out on the floor.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Alright, you’re ready. Let’s head into the work area.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

chapters.name: Chapter 3: Move the Rebin Cart to Scanning

actions.Name: ChecklistUIToggle
actions.Data: {"titleText":"Rebin Cart Operations – Move the Rebin Cart to Scanning","toggleInfos":["Collect the Rebin Cart","Move Toward the Scanning Area","Aisle Crossing Incident","Cross the Aisle Safely","Park at the Scanning Area"],"waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Alright, your first task is to take this Rebin Cart to the scanning area.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Just take one cart at a time, even when it’s empty.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Before you set off, check that the wheel locks are released.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"These are operated with your foot. I’ll show you how.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Now take hold of the cart with both hands.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Take hold of the cart with both hands.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Use both hands to hold the highlighted handle.","waitForCompletion":true}

moments.name: Moment 2 – Move Toward the Scanning Area

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"While you’re moving the cart, keep your phone away and your attention on the path.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"There’s an aisle intersection just ahead. Watch what happens here.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"See what happened? The Spider entered the crossing without calling ‘Corner.’","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"At every crossing or blind corner, slow down, check the path, and call ‘Corner’ before entering.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"You entered the crossing without warning the associate on the other side.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Think back to what you just saw. Give it another try.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Good. That lets anyone coming from the other side know you’re there.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

moments.name: Moment 5 – Park at the Scanning Area

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Here we are at Scanning. Park the cart fully inside the blue marked space.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Keep it off the anti-fatigue mat as you park. The soft surface can affect the cart’s stability and control.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Keep the cart off the mat. Stay on the solid floor.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Bring the cart fully inside the blue markings.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Move the cart into the highlighted space.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Let me align the rebin cart within the parking area.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Good. Once the cart is in position, the wheel locks need to be engaged.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"While that’s being done, remember — never climb onto the cart or use the racks as a step.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Scanning’s complete. Before we move, make sure the load isn’t blocking your view.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

chapters.name: Chapter 4: Move the Rebin Cart to Packing Area

actions.Data: {"titleText":"Rebin Cart Operations – Move the Rebin Cart to Packing Area","toggleInfos":["Move to the Packing Area","Respond to the Fallen Item","Move to the Packing Area","Introduction to the Buffer Area","Tipping Incident"],"waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Now, the wheel locks need to be released.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Alright, take hold of the cart and head toward Packing.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Take hold of the cart and continue toward Packing.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grab the cart with both hands and follow the highlighted route.","waitForCompletion":true}

moments.name: Moment 2 – Respond to the Fallen Item

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Hold on — something just fell from the cart.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: MCQResponseAction
actions.Data: {"questionIndex":1,"questionText":"What should you do if an item falls off the rebin cart?","optionsList":["Pick up the item","Leave the item where it is"],"correctOptionIndex":[2],"showAnswerDuration":3.0,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"What should you do if an item falls off the rebin cart?","waitForCompletion":false,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Keep moving along the green route toward Packing.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Leave it where it is. Don’t reach for it while you’re handling the cart.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

moments.name: Moment 3 – Move to the Packing Area

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Take the cart into Packing and park it inside the blue marked space.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Let me align the rebin cart within the packing area.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Before packing begins, the wheel locks need to be engaged.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Keep following the green route into Packing.","waitForCompletion":true}

moments.name: Moment 4 – Introduction to the Buffer Area

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"While your cart’s being processed, take a look over at the buffer area.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"If Packing is full, carts wait here until a space opens up.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"There’s a space available now, so the cart in the buffer can move into Packing.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"See what happened? The cart caught on an obstruction and started to tip.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"If a cart starts going over, don’t try to stop it with your hands, feet, or body.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: ChecklistUIToggle
actions.Data: {"titleText":"Rebin Cart Operations – Move back to Parking Area","toggleInfos":["Return the Rebin Cart to Parking","Park the Rebin Cart"],"waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Alright, back to your cart. Packing’s complete, and it’s empty now. Let’s return it to parking.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Before we move, the wheel locks need to be released.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Take the empty cart back to the parking area along the green route.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Take the empty cart back along the green route.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Follow the highlighted route back to parking.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Park the cart fully inside the blue marked space.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Bring the whole cart inside the blue markings.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Good. The cart’s in position. The wheel locks need to be engaged before we leave it parked.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Nice work. You’ve completed the Rebin Cart task safely.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}
